mapper.select: SELECT A.EPISODE AS LocalDateTimeEpisode, B.USER_ID AS userId, A.LOCATION AS location FROM MEETING_SCHEDULE A LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) B ON A.EPISODE = B.EPISODE WHERE A.COMPLETE_FLAG = 'N' AND A.EPISODE > DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 HOUR) ORDER BY A.EPISODE ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PARTICIPANT_USER(USER_ID, EPISODE, SEX, NICKNAME) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{episode}, (SELECT SEX FROM USER_TABLE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}), ( SELECT VALUE1 FROM ( SELECT VALUE1 FROM CRITERIA_DATA WHERE DIVISION = ( SELECT CASE WHEN SEX = '남성' THEN 'male_nickname' ELSE 'female_nickname' END FROM USER_TABLE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ) AND VALUE1 NOT IN ( SELECT NICKNAME FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE EPISODE = #{episode} ) ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1 ) AS AA ) )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND EPISODE = #{episode}
mapper.select: SELECT pass_flag FROM user_manage WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND PASS_FLAG = 'Y'
